title.zh: MYRIAD披露内部钱包私钥泄露事件，将作废10个市场并自动退款
title.en: MYRIAD披露内部钱包私钥泄露事件，将作废10个市场并自动退款

current_state.zh: MYRIAD disclosed that a leaked internal wallet private key, stemming from a third-party library flaw in its backend, was used to manipulate settlement of 10 AMM prediction markets on BNB Chain; the team revoked the wallet's permissions within minutes, voided the 10 markets, and will automatically refund holders at pre-attack prices using recovered funds and market liquidity.
